newsitem.title: USA: Hardinge stake cut by chairman.
newsitem.headline: Hardinge stake cut by chairman.

text.p: Robert Agan, chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Hardinge Inc said Tuesday he cut his stake in the company to 293,063 common shares or 4.5 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Agan said his latest transactions include the sale of 38,000 common shares between April 24 and May 28 at prices ranging from $25.375 to $25.75 per share.
On June 5 Agan transferred 40,000 common shares at a price of $26.375 per share to Greene Street Exchange Fund L.P.
Hardinge, based in Elmira, N.Y., is a machine tool manufacturer.
